summary_1line: Uttara reveals a mysterious celestial youth won the battle, while Arjuna remains disguised; later the Pandavas appear royally, provoking Virata’s anger at Kanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Uttara trembles on the chariot while a radiant warrior single‑handedly showers arrows upon the Kuru army.
The celestial hero laughs amid shattered chariots and strips the defeated Kuru warriors of their garments like a tiger among beasts.
The five Pandavas, bathed and dressed in white with shining ornaments, stride into Virata’s hall like five mighty elephants and sit upon royal thrones.
